origin.zh: 传统画面中，一个披红斗篷的人在月夜背对八只叠放的杯子，拄杖走向荒凉的山中，天上是月蚀般的月亮。它是主动的离开：放下已经不再滋养你的东西，去追寻意义。
origin.en: Traditionally a red-cloaked figure turns from eight stacked cups and walks with a staff into barren hills under an eclipsed moon. It is a deliberate departure: leaving what no longer nourishes you to seek meaning.

astro.zh: 双鱼座第一旬 · 土星（0–10°）

love.zh: 一段关系已经无法满足内心，选择离开或暂停。
love.en: A relationship no longer fulfils you; you choose to leave or pause.

work.zh: 辞职、转行，或放下一个做得不错却没意义的项目。
work.en: Quitting, changing careers, or dropping a good but empty project.

advice.zh: 问问自己：你在找的到底是什么？
advice.en: Ask yourself: what are you really looking for?

love.zh: 明知不合适却舍不得走。
love.en: Knowing it's wrong but unable to leave.

work.zh: 反复横跳，迟迟下不了离开的决心。
work.en: Going back and forth, unable to commit to leaving.

advice.zh: 离开不是失败，是换个方向找。
advice.en: Leaving isn't failing — it's searching elsewhere.

up.zh: 俗称「愿望牌」。九只杯子摆成一排，你满意地坐着——想要的东西大多已经得到，好好享受吧。
up.en: Known as the 'wish card'. Nine cups in a row and you sit contentedly — most of what you wanted is here. Enjoy it.

rev.zh: 得到了却仍不满足，或者过度沉溺于享乐。
rev.en: Having it all yet still unsatisfied, or indulging too much.

whispers.zh: 九个杯子都是我的。我一个都不打算分。
whispers.en: All nine cups are mine. I don't plan to share any.

whispers.zh: 我抱着手坐着。这是一种很满足的姿势。
whispers.en: I'm sitting with my arms folded. It's a very satisfied pose.

scene.zh: 温暖的傍晚金光下，奶蛙心满意足地坐在长椅上，短手交叠在肚子上，面前铺着深蓝桌布的弧形长桌上排着九只圣杯，后面是花园喷泉。
scene.en: In warm golden evening light Naiwa sits contentedly on a bench, arms folded over its belly, nine chalices arranged on a curved blue-draped table, a garden fountain behind.

origin.zh: 韦特牌中，一个体态丰满的人双臂抱胸坐着，身后弧形桌上排列着九只杯子，神情满足。它常被称为「愿望牌」，代表物质与情感上的满足和惬意。
origin.en: In the Rider–Waite card a stout, satisfied man sits arms folded before nine cups on a curved table. Often called the 'wish card', it signals material and emotional contentment.

astro.zh: 双鱼座第二旬 · 木星（10–20°）

love.zh: 感情甜蜜满足，心愿成真。
love.en: Sweet, satisfying love; wishes come true.

work.zh: 达成目标、收获回报，生活舒适。
work.en: Goals reached, rewards gained, life comfortable.

advice.zh: 允许自己享受，不必立刻追求下一个目标。
advice.en: Let yourself enjoy it before chasing the next goal.

love.zh: 表面满足，心里却空落落的。
love.en: Content on the surface, empty underneath.

work.zh: 过度消费、贪多，或满足来得太浅。
work.en: Overspending, greed, or shallow satisfaction.

advice.zh: 想想什么才是真正让你满足的。
advice.en: Think about what truly satisfies you.

up.zh: 彩虹上挂着十只杯子，一家人在河边欢欣起舞。情感上的圆满与长久的幸福。
up.en: Ten cups arc across a rainbow while a family dances by the river. Emotional fulfilment and lasting happiness.

rev.zh: 家庭不和、价值观冲突，或对「完美家庭」的期待太高。
rev.en: Family discord, clashing values, or too-high expectations of the perfect family.

whispers.zh: 彩虹上有十个杯子。下雨的时候它们在接水。
whispers.en: Ten cups on the rainbow. When it rains, they collect the water.

whispers.zh: 小的那两只在跳舞。我也想跳，但我在负责举手。
whispers.en: The two little ones are dancing. I'd like to dance too, but I'm in charge of raising my arms.

scene.zh: 雨后清透的阳光下，四只奶蛙站在河岸边，两只大的向天空张开短手，彩虹上排着十只圣杯，两只小奶蛙手拉手跳舞，对岸是温馨的小屋和绿色山丘。
scene.en: In clear light after rain four Naiwas stand on a riverbank — two big ones raising their arms to a rainbow of ten cups, two small ones dancing hand in hand, a cosy cottage on the far bank.

origin.zh: 传统画面中，一对夫妇张开双臂迎向天上由十只杯子组成的彩虹，两个孩子在旁边嬉戏，远处是家园。它是情感层面的最高圆满：和谐的家庭与持久的幸福。
origin.en: Traditionally a couple raise their arms to a rainbow of ten cups while two children play nearby, a home in the distance. It is emotional fulfilment at its height: a harmonious family and lasting joy.

astro.zh: 双鱼座第三旬 · 火星（20–30°）

love.zh: 关系稳定幸福，适合组建家庭、长期承诺。
love.en: Stable, happy love; good for building a family or lasting commitment.

work.zh: 工作与生活平衡，团队像家人一样。
work.en: Work-life balance; a team that feels like family.

advice.zh: 今天给家人或重要的人打个电话。
advice.en: Call your family or someone dear today.

love.zh: 家人反对，或两个人对未来的想象不一致。
love.en: Family disapproval, or different visions of the future.

work.zh: 为了维持表面和谐而压抑真实感受。
work.en: Suppressing real feelings to keep up appearances.

advice.zh: 幸福不需要完美的样子。
advice.en: Happiness doesn't need to look perfect.

up.zh: 杯子里探出一条小鱼——意想不到的惊喜、温柔的心意或一个创意的萌芽。保持一颗柔软好奇的心。
up.en: A little fish peeks out of the cup — an unexpected surprise, a tender message, or a creative spark. Keep a soft, curious heart.

rev.zh: 情绪化、不切实际，或者把心意藏着不敢表达。
rev.en: Moody, unrealistic, or hiding feelings out of shyness.

whispers.zh: 杯子里有一条鱼。它看着我，我看着它。我们都没有表情。
whispers.en: There's a fish in my cup. It looks at me, I look at it. Neither of us has an expression.

whispers.zh: 帽子上的百合是我自己插的。海风把它吹歪了。
whispers.en: I stuck the lily in my hat myself. The sea wind knocked it crooked.

scene.zh: 粉蓝色的海边清晨，奶蛙披着淡蓝短斗篷、戴着插百合的软帽，站在浪边举着一只圣杯，杯里探出一条银色小鱼。
scene.en: On a pink-and-blue seaside morning Naiwa in a pale blue cape and a floppy hat with a lily stands at the water's edge holding up a cup, a little silver fish peeking out.

origin.zh: 韦特牌中，一位衣着华丽的年轻人站在海边，惊奇地看着从杯中探出头的鱼。圣杯侍从代表感性的信使：情书、邀请、直觉的灵光与艺术的萌芽。
origin.en: In the Rider–Waite card a richly dressed youth by the sea gazes in surprise at a fish rising from his cup. The Page of Cups is a messenger of feeling: love notes, invitations, intuitive flashes and budding art.

astro.zh: 水中之土（宫廷牌元素，现代常用对应）
astro.en: Earth of Water (court element, common modern attribution)

love.zh: 收到一份温柔的告白或小惊喜。
love.en: A tender confession or a sweet surprise.

work.zh: 创意灵感冒出来，适合尝试艺术或设计。
work.en: Creative ideas bubble up — try art or design.

advice.zh: 相信那个看似天真的念头。
advice.en: Trust the idea that seems naïve.

love.zh: 情绪起伏大，或者用幻想逃避现实。
love.en: Mood swings, or escaping into fantasy.

work.zh: 想法太天马行空，难以落地。
work.en: Ideas too far-fetched to land.

advice.zh: 温柔可以保留，但要说出来。
advice.en: Keep your tenderness — and say it out loud.

up.zh: 骑士捧着杯子缓缓渡河而来，带来浪漫的邀请或一个由心出发的提议。跟着感觉走。
up.en: The knight crosses the river slowly, cup held forward — a romantic invitation or a heartfelt proposal. Follow your feelings.

rev.zh: 甜言蜜语不可靠，或情绪化、不切实际的追求。
rev.en: Sweet talk you can't trust, or a moody, unrealistic pursuit.

whispers.zh: 我的头盔上有一对小翅膀。它们不会飞，但会让我走得更浪漫。
whispers.en: My helmet has little wings. They can't fly, but they make me travel more romantically.

whispers.zh: 马走得很慢。我捧着杯子，一滴都没洒。
whispers.en: The horse walks slowly. I'm holding the cup and haven't spilled a drop.

scene.zh: 朦胧的上午金银色光里，奶蛙穿着银甲、头盔上有小翅膀，骑着白马缓缓渡过浅河，双手向前捧着一只圣杯，两岸垂柳和百合。
scene.en: In hazy gold-silver morning light Naiwa in silver armour and a winged helmet rides a white horse across a shallow river, holding a chalice forward, willows and lilies on the banks.

origin.zh: 韦特牌中，骑士戴着有翼头盔，骑着白马缓步前进，手中捧杯如同献礼。与其他骑士的冲锋不同，他代表温柔的追求、浪漫的邀请与理想主义。
origin.en: In the Rider–Waite card a knight in a winged helmet rides a white horse at a gentle pace, cup held out like an offering. Unlike the other charging knights, he is gentle pursuit, romantic invitation and idealism.

astro.zh: 水中之风（宫廷牌元素，现代常用对应）
astro.en: Air of Water (court element, common modern attribution)

love.zh: 浪漫的追求者、约会邀请或求婚。
love.en: A romantic suitor, a date invitation, or a proposal.

work.zh: 收到创意类工作邀约，或跟随热情转换方向。
work.en: A creative job offer, or changing direction to follow your passion.

advice.zh: 用心表达，但也要准备好行动。
advice.en: Express it from the heart — and be ready to act.

love.zh: 对方说得好听做得少，或你沉迷于浪漫想象。
love.en: All words and no action, or lost in romantic fantasy.

work.zh: 情绪化决定，事后后悔。
work.en: Emotional decisions you later regret.

advice.zh: 看对方怎么做，而不只是怎么说。
advice.en: Watch what they do, not just what they say.

up.zh: 她坐在海边凝视着一只带盖的圣杯，读得懂别人没说出口的情绪。用共情和直觉去照顾人，也照顾自己。
up.en: She sits by the sea gazing into a lidded cup, reading emotions no one has voiced. Care for others with empathy and intuition — and care for yourself.

rev.zh: 情绪被别人带着走，过度付出，或者把感受藏得太深。
rev.en: Swept up by others' feelings, over-giving, or hiding emotions too deep.

whispers.zh: 这个杯子有盖子。我不打开，我只是看着它。这就是直觉。
whispers.en: This cup has a lid. I don't open it, I just look at it. That's intuition.

whispers.zh: 浪花碰到我的脚。凉的。我没有动。
whispers.en: A wave touched my feet. Cold. I didn't move.

scene.zh: 柔和的银色阴天下，奶蛙戴着珍珠小冠、披着海蓝斗篷，坐在刻着贝壳与小海兽的石座上，双手捧着一只精致的带盖圣杯静静凝视，浪花拍着脚边的鹅卵石。
scene.en: Under soft silver overcast light Naiwa, in a pearl crown and sea-blue cape, sits on a stone throne carved with shells and sea creatures, gazing into an ornate lidded cup while waves wash the pebbles at its feet.

origin.zh: 传统画面中，王后坐在海边贝壳装饰的王座上，凝视一只饰有天使的带盖圣杯——那是全套牌里唯一有盖的杯子。她是情感与直觉的掌握者，深情、包容又神秘。
origin.en: Traditionally the Queen sits on a shell-carved throne at the shore, gazing into an ornate lidded cup decorated with angels — the only closed cup in the deck. She masters feeling and intuition: loving, accepting and mysterious.

astro.zh: 水中之水（宫廷牌元素，现代常用对应）
astro.en: Water of Water (court element, common modern attribution)

love.zh: 温柔体贴、懂得倾听的伴侣，关系里情感交流很深。
love.en: A caring, listening partner; deep emotional exchange.

work.zh: 适合照护、咨询、艺术类工作，凭直觉判断会很准。
work.en: Good for caregiving, counselling or art; your intuition is sharp.

advice.zh: 今天先听听自己的感受。
advice.en: Listen to your own feelings first today.

love.zh: 情绪依赖，或总在照顾别人而忽略自己。
love.en: Emotional dependence, or always caring for others but not yourself.

work.zh: 被他人情绪消耗，判断失去客观。
work.en: Drained by others' moods, losing objectivity.

advice.zh: 设一点边界，你的杯子也需要盖子。
advice.en: Set some boundaries — your cup needs a lid too.

up.zh: 王座漂在汹涌的海上，他却平静地坐着。情绪成熟的人能感受一切，又不被淹没。
up.en: The throne floats on a rough sea, yet he sits calmly. Emotional maturity means feeling everything without being drowned.

rev.zh: 压抑情绪、冷漠疏离，或者表面平静内心翻涌。
rev.en: Repressed feelings, coldness, or calm on the surface with turmoil beneath.

whispers.zh: 我的王座漂在海上。船晃，我不晃。
whispers.en: My throne floats on the sea. The ship rocks; I don't.

whispers.zh: 旁边跳起一条鱼。它在问我还好吗。我说还好。
whispers.en: A fish leapt beside me. It asked if I was okay. I said I was.

scene.zh: 暴风雨中透出几缕阳光，奶蛙戴着小金冠、穿深蓝长袍，平静地坐在漂浮于翻滚海面的石座上，一手圣杯一手短杖，一侧银鱼跃出水面，另一侧帆船在浪里起伏。
scene.en: Under stormy skies with breaks of sun, Naiwa in a small crown and deep blue robe sits calmly on a stone throne floating on rolling waves, holding a cup and a short sceptre; a silver fish leaps on one side, a ship rides the swell on the other.

origin.zh: 韦特牌中，国王的王座漂浮在波涛汹涌的海面上，他一手持杯一手持杖，身旁跃出一条鱼，远处有船。他代表在情感风浪中保持平衡的成熟与慈悲。
origin.en: In the Rider–Waite card the King's throne floats on a turbulent sea; he holds a cup and sceptre, a fish leaps beside him and a ship sails beyond. He is maturity and compassion that stay balanced amid emotional storms.

astro.zh: 水中之火（宫廷牌元素，现代常用对应）
astro.en: Fire of Water (court element, common modern attribution)

love.zh: 成熟稳重、情绪稳定的伴侣，能包容彼此的波动。
love.en: A mature, steady partner who can hold both your ups and downs.

work.zh: 适合调解、管理、心理或医疗相关的角色。
work.en: Good for mediating, managing, or roles in therapy or care.

advice.zh: 遇事先深呼吸，再开口。
advice.en: Take a deep breath before you speak.

love.zh: 情绪冷处理，让对方感觉被拒之门外。
love.en: Cold-shouldering that shuts the other out.

work.zh: 压力下情绪失控，或用控制代替沟通。
work.en: Losing your temper under pressure, or controlling instead of talking.

advice.zh: 平静不是压住，而是允许它流过。
advice.en: Calm isn't holding it down — it's letting it pass through.

up.zh: 一把剑劈开云层，思路突然清晰。真相、决断和新的想法像一道光，帮你斩断混乱。
up.en: A sword cuts through the clouds and your mind clears. Truth, decisiveness and a new idea slice through confusion like light.

rev.zh: 想法混乱、判断失准，或者用尖锐的言语伤了人。
rev.en: Muddled thinking, poor judgement, or sharp words that wound.

whispers.zh: 剑尖上挂着桂冠。它掉下来的时候，我会接住。
whispers.en: There's a laurel on the sword's tip. When it falls, I'll catch it.

whispers.zh: 风很大。羽毛都飞走了，我的想法也清楚了。
whispers.en: The wind is strong. The feathers blew away, and my thoughts cleared.

scene.zh: 冷灰色的天光与疾风中，一只光做的手从明亮的云里伸出，握着一把剑尖挂着金色桂冠的银剑；奶蛙站在嶙峋的山岩上仰头看着，白羽在风里飞。
scene.en: In cold grey light and racing wind a hand of light from a bright cloud holds a silver sword crowned with a golden laurel; Naiwa looks up from jagged crags as white feathers blow past.

origin.zh: 韦特牌中，一只手从云中握着直立的剑，剑尖戴着王冠，王冠上垂下橄榄枝与棕榈叶，下方是荒凉的山峰。它是风元素之根：理性、真相与决断的力量。
origin.en: In the Rider–Waite card a hand from a cloud grips an upright sword crowned with a diadem hung with olive and palm, above barren peaks. It is the root of Air: intellect, truth and decisive force.

astro.zh: 风元素之根

love.zh: 把话说清楚，关系反而会更明朗。
love.en: Saying it plainly will clear the air between you.

work.zh: 新思路、关键决定、谈判中占上风。
work.en: A new idea, a key decision, the upper hand in negotiation.

advice.zh: 先写下事实，再写下感受，分开看。
advice.en: Write down the facts, then the feelings — look at them separately.

love.zh: 言语伤人，或者因为误会而争执。
love.en: Hurtful words, or arguments born of misunderstanding.

work.zh: 判断错误、信息混乱，迟迟做不了决定。
work.en: Wrong calls, confused information, indecision.

advice.zh: 话出口前，先想想它会落在哪里。
advice.en: Before speaking, think where the words will land.

up.zh: 你闭着眼睛、双剑交叉护在胸前，试图不去面对选择。平静只是暂时的，迟早需要睁眼。
up.en: Eyes closed, two swords crossed over your heart, you try not to face the choice. The calm is temporary; sooner or later you must look.

rev.zh: 终于睁开眼面对真相，或者被信息淹没、更加混乱。
rev.en: Finally opening your eyes to the truth — or overwhelmed by information and more confused.

whispers.zh: 我闭着眼睛。不是在睡觉，是在不做决定。
whispers.en: My eyes are closed. Not sleeping — just not deciding.

whispers.zh: 两把剑交叉在胸前。很重，但很安全。
whispers.en: Two swords crossed over my chest. Heavy, but safe.

scene.zh: 平静的蓝色月夜，奶蛙坐在海边石凳上，闭着眼睛，双手交叉握着两把长剑护在胸前，身后平静的海面上立着几块礁石。
scene.en: On a calm blue moonlit night Naiwa sits on a stone bench by the sea, eyes closed, two long swords crossed over its chest, rocks rising from the still water behind.

origin.zh: 传统画面中，一位蒙眼女子坐在海边，双手交叉持剑于胸前，背后是礁石与新月。它代表僵持与回避：用不看来保持平衡，却也因此无法前进。
origin.en: Traditionally a blindfolded woman sits by the sea with two swords crossed over her chest, rocks and a crescent moon behind. It is stalemate and avoidance: balance kept by not looking — and so no movement.

astro.zh: 天秤座第一旬 · 月亮（0–10°）

love.zh: 在两个人或两个选择之间犹豫，或冷战僵持。
love.en: Torn between two people or choices, or a cold standoff.

work.zh: 决策卡住，信息不够，不敢拍板。
work.en: A stuck decision, not enough information, afraid to commit.

advice.zh: 把两个选项都写下来，睁眼看一遍。
advice.en: Write both options down and look at them with open eyes.

love.zh: 真相浮出，不得不面对。
love.en: The truth surfaces and must be faced.

work.zh: 被太多意见拉扯，越想越乱。
work.en: Pulled by too many opinions, more confused the more you think.

advice.zh: 选一个，然后让自己承担它。
advice.en: Choose one, and let yourself own it.

up.zh: 三把剑穿过一颗心，大雨落下。心碎是真实的痛，但哭出来也是疗愈的开始。
up.en: Three swords pierce a heart as rain falls. Heartbreak is real pain — but letting it out is where healing begins.

rev.zh: 伤口在慢慢愈合，开始原谅和放下；也可能是一直压着不肯哭。
rev.en: The wound is slowly healing, forgiveness beginning — or tears you still refuse to shed.

whispers.zh: 那颗心是石头做的。所以我没有哭。我只是打了伞。
whispers.en: That heart is made of stone, so I didn't cry. I just opened my umbrella.

whispers.zh: 雨会停的。伞也会收起来的。
whispers.en: The rain will stop. The umbrella will close too.

scene.zh: 冷灰色的雨天，一颗石雕般的深红色心悬在乌云前，被三把银剑干净地穿过；奶蛙撑着一把小黑伞站在雨里，平静地抬头看着。
scene.en: On a cold grey rainy day a carved crimson stone heart hangs before dark clouds, cleanly pierced by three silver swords; Naiwa stands in the rain under a small black umbrella, looking up calmly.

origin.zh: 韦特牌中，一颗红心被三把剑刺穿，背景是灰色的暴雨云。它是塔罗中最直白的悲伤：心碎、背叛、失去，也代表痛过之后的清醒。
origin.en: In the Rider–Waite card a red heart pierced by three swords hangs against grey storm clouds. It is tarot's plainest sorrow — heartbreak, betrayal, loss — and the clarity that follows pain.

astro.zh: 天秤座第二旬 · 土星（10–20°）

love.zh: 失恋、背叛，或一句话深深刺痛了你。
love.en: A breakup, betrayal, or words that cut deep.

work.zh: 被否定、被批评，或合作中出现伤人的冲突。
work.en: Rejection, criticism, or a hurtful clash at work.

advice.zh: 允许自己难过，给眼泪一个出口。
advice.en: Let yourself be sad; give the tears a way out.

love.zh: 慢慢走出伤痛，学会原谅。
love.en: Slowly moving past the hurt, learning to forgive.

work.zh: 从打击中恢复，重新振作。
work.en: Recovering from a blow, getting back up.

advice.zh: 伤疤可以留着，痛可以放下。
advice.en: Keep the scar; let go of the pain.

up.zh: 奶蛙安静地躺在石凳上休息，剑挂在墙上。战斗之后需要停下来，好好恢复。
up.en: Naiwa lies quietly resting on a stone bench, swords hung on the wall. After the fight comes a needed pause to recover.

rev.zh: 该休息却停不下来，或者休息够了、准备重新出发。
rev.en: Unable to stop when you need rest — or rested enough and ready to return.

whispers.zh: 我在休息。剑也在休息。
whispers.en: I'm resting. The swords are resting too.

whispers.zh: 窗外的光照在我肚子上。暖暖的，我不想起来。
whispers.en: Light from the window falls on my belly. It's warm. I don't want to get up.

scene.zh: 清晨淡淡的天光从花窗照进安静的拱顶大厅，奶蛙仰躺在雕花石凳上，短手放在肚子上闭眼休息，墙上挂着三把剑，石凳下还横着一把。
scene.en: Pale morning light falls through a leaded window into a quiet vaulted hall where Naiwa lies on a carved stone bench, hands on its belly, eyes closed; three swords hang on the wall and one lies beneath the bench.

origin.zh: 传统画面中，一位骑士的石像双手合十躺在墓上，墙上挂着三把剑，身下还有一把，旁边是彩绘玻璃窗。它不是死亡，而是休战、静养与沉思。
origin.en: Traditionally a knight's effigy lies on a tomb with hands joined in prayer, three swords above and one beneath, beside a stained-glass window. It is not death but truce, recuperation and contemplation.

astro.zh: 天秤座第三旬 · 木星（20–30°）

love.zh: 关系需要冷静期，给彼此一点空间。
love.en: The relationship needs a cooling-off period and some space.

work.zh: 休假、调整节奏，或暂停一个项目。
work.en: Time off, a slower pace, or pausing a project.

advice.zh: 今天允许自己什么都不做一小时。
advice.en: Allow yourself one hour of doing nothing today.

love.zh: 冷静期太长，变成了冷漠。
love.en: The break goes on too long and turns cold.

work.zh: 身心透支却还在硬撑，或休整结束该重新出发。
work.en: Burned out but still pushing — or rested and ready to go.

advice.zh: 休息不是浪费时间。
advice.en: Rest isn't wasted time.

up.zh: 你赢了，收起了别人的剑，但对方垂头离开。这样的胜利值得吗？有时候赢了争吵，却输了关系。
up.en: You won and gathered the swords, but the others walk off dejected. Was it worth it? Sometimes you win the argument and lose the relationship.

rev.zh: 争执平息，愿意和解；或者终于承认自己也有错。
rev.en: The conflict settles and you're ready to reconcile — or you admit you were wrong too.

whispers.zh: 我拿了三把剑。他们走了。海风很冷。
whispers.en: I took three swords. They left. The sea wind is cold.

whispers.zh: 我回头看了看他们。我也不知道我赢了什么。
whispers.en: I looked back at them. I'm not sure what I won.

scene.zh: 冷灰色的午后，奶蛙在大风的海滩上抱起三把银剑，回头看着两个低头走向海边的小小身影，沙滩上还躺着两把剑。
scene.en: On a cold grey afternoon Naiwa gathers three silver swords on a windswept beach, glancing back at two small figures walking away toward the sea, two more swords on the sand.

origin.zh: 韦特牌中，一个人得意地拾起剑，身后两人沮丧地走向海边，天空云层破碎。它代表不择手段的胜利、冲突的代价与人际上的损伤。
origin.en: In the Rider–Waite card a smirking man collects swords while two others trudge dejectedly toward the sea under a torn sky. It stands for winning at any cost and the damage conflict leaves behind.

astro.zh: 水瓶座第一旬 · 金星（0–10°）

love.zh: 争吵中谁都想赢，结果两败俱伤。
love.en: Both want to win the fight; both end up hurt.

work.zh: 职场斗争、勾心斗角，赢了也不舒服。
work.en: Office politics and scheming — even winning feels bad.

advice.zh: 想想你更想要「赢」还是「好」。
advice.en: Ask whether you'd rather be right or be well.

love.zh: 放下面子，愿意主动和好。
love.en: Swallowing pride and reaching out to make up.

work.zh: 冲突告一段落，开始修复关系。
work.en: The conflict ends; repair begins.

advice.zh: 道歉不是认输。
advice.en: Apologizing isn't losing.

up.zh: 小船载着六把剑，从湍急的水面驶向平静的彼岸。离开困境的路虽然安静，却在一点点变好。
up.en: A small boat carries six swords from rough water toward a calmer shore. The way out of trouble is quiet, but it's getting better bit by bit.

rev.zh: 想离开却走不了，或者带着旧包袱上路。
rev.en: Wanting to leave but stuck, or carrying old baggage into the new place.

whispers.zh: 我在撑船。船上的那位一直没说话。我也没说。
whispers.en: I'm poling the boat. The one aboard hasn't said a word. Neither have I.

whispers.zh: 这边的水很急，前面的水很平。我们慢慢过去。
whispers.en: The water here is rough; ahead it's calm. We'll get there slowly.

scene.zh: 清冷的黎明，奶蛙站在小木船的船尾撑篙，船头坐着一个安静的披斗篷小身影，船上立着六把银剑；一边是湍急的水，前方是平静的水面和远处有塔楼的海岸。
scene.en: In a cool dawn Naiwa poles a small wooden boat from the stern, a quiet cloaked figure at the bow, six silver swords standing in the boat; rough water to one side, calm water and a towered shore ahead.

origin.zh: 传统画面中，船夫撑着载有母子的小船驶向对岸，船上插着六把剑；船一侧水流湍急，另一侧平静。它是带着伤痛的过渡与迁移：离开风暴，驶向更安稳的地方。
origin.en: Traditionally a ferryman poles a boat carrying a woman and child toward a far shore, six swords planted in the boat, rough water on one side and calm on the other. It is transition carrying old wounds: leaving the storm for steadier ground.

astro.zh: 水瓶座第二旬 · 水星（10–20°）

love.zh: 从一段难熬的关系里走出来，或两个人一起渡过难关。
love.en: Leaving a painful relationship, or getting through hard times together.

work.zh: 换环境、换岗位，或项目从混乱进入平稳期。
work.en: A change of place or role, or a project moving from chaos to calm.

advice.zh: 不必一下子到岸，先离开湍流。
advice.en: You don't have to reach shore at once — just leave the rapids.

love.zh: 旧问题没解决，换了地方又重演。
love.en: Unresolved issues repeat in the new place.

work.zh: 拖着不走，或走得很不甘心。
work.en: Delaying the move, or leaving resentfully.

advice.zh: 放下几把剑，船会轻一点。
advice.en: Set down a few swords; the boat will be lighter.

up.zh: 奶蛙抱着五把剑悄悄溜走，还回头看了一眼。也许是聪明的策略，也许是不太光彩的小动作——要看你是谁。
up.en: Naiwa tiptoes off with five swords, glancing back. Clever strategy or a not-so-honest move — it depends on who you are.

rev.zh: 秘密被揭穿、良心不安，或者决定坦白和归还。
rev.en: A secret exposed, a guilty conscience, or deciding to confess and give it back.

whispers.zh: 我拿了五把剑。剩下两把太重了。不是因为我有良心。
whispers.en: I took five swords. The other two were too heavy. Not because I have a conscience.

whispers.zh: 我回头看了一眼。没有人发现。我继续踮脚。
whispers.en: I looked back. Nobody noticed. I kept tiptoeing.

scene.zh: 雾蒙蒙的灰色清晨，奶蛙抱着五把银剑踮着脚从一片彩色帐篷边溜走，回头瞥了一眼，身后地上还插着两把剑。
scene.en: On a misty grey morning Naiwa tiptoes away from a cluster of colourful tents hugging five silver swords, glancing back, two swords left planted in the ground.

origin.zh: 韦特牌中，一个人抱着五把剑踮脚离开营地，回头偷看，身后留下两把。它代表计谋、隐瞒、独自行事，也可能是机智的脱身。
origin.en: In the Rider–Waite card a man tiptoes away from a camp carrying five swords, looking back, two left behind. It signifies cunning, concealment, acting alone — or a clever escape.

astro.zh: 水瓶座第三旬 · 月亮（20–30°）

love.zh: 关系里有隐瞒或不坦白的部分。
love.en: Something hidden or unspoken in the relationship.

work.zh: 需要策略和巧思，但小心别越界；也要防人之心。
work.en: Strategy and wit help, but don't cross lines — and watch your back.

advice.zh: 想清楚：你在保护自己，还是在逃避？
advice.en: Ask: are you protecting yourself, or running away?

love.zh: 谎言被拆穿，或终于选择坦诚。
love.en: A lie uncovered, or finally choosing honesty.

work.zh: 计谋失败，或良心过不去。
work.en: A scheme fails, or your conscience won't rest.

advice.zh: 把拿走的东西还回去，心会轻一些。
advice.en: Return what you took; your heart will feel lighter.

up.zh: 奶蛙被丝带松松地缠着，周围插着八把剑。看起来被困住了，其实丝带一挣就开——困住你的更多是想法。
up.en: Naiwa is loosely wrapped in ribbon, ringed by eight swords. It looks trapped, yet the ribbon would slip with one shrug — what holds you is mostly thought.

rev.zh: 意识到自己其实可以离开，开始一点点挣脱束缚。
rev.en: Realizing you can leave after all, and starting to slip free.

whispers.zh: 我被丝带绑着。其实很松。我只是还没想好往哪走。
whispers.en: I'm tied up with ribbon. It's actually loose. I just haven't decided where to go.

whispers.zh: 地上湿湿的。剑一直站着。我也一直站着。
whispers.en: The ground is wet. The swords keep standing. So do I.

scene.zh: 雾气笼罩的阴天湿地上，奶蛙身上松松地缠着白丝带，周围一圈插着八把银剑，远处山上有座城堡。
scene.en: On a misty overcast marsh Naiwa stands loosely wrapped in white ribbon, ringed by eight silver swords planted in the ground, a castle on a distant hill.

origin.zh: 传统画面中，一位被蒙眼、松绑的女子站在泥地里，周围立着八把剑，远处是城堡。绳索并不牢固，剑也没有完全围住她——它讲的是自我设限与无力感。
origin.en: Traditionally a blindfolded, loosely bound woman stands in mud surrounded by eight swords, a castle beyond. The bonds are loose and the swords don't fully enclose her — it is about self-imposed limits and helplessness.

astro.zh: 双子座第一旬 · 木星（0–10°）

love.zh: 觉得被困在关系里，却不敢改变。
love.en: Feeling stuck in the relationship but afraid to change.

work.zh: 工作上感到受限、无路可走，其实还有选择。
work.en: Feeling boxed in at work, though there are options.

advice.zh: 列出三个你以为「不可能」的选项，再看一遍。
advice.en: List three options you think are 'impossible' and look again.

love.zh: 开始为自己争取空间。
love.en: Starting to claim space for yourself.

work.zh: 打破思维定式，找到出路。
work.en: Breaking old thinking and finding a way out.

advice.zh: 动一动手，丝带就会松开。
advice.en: Move your hands — the ribbon will loosen.

up.zh: 深夜在床上坐起，双手捂脸，墙上挂着九把剑。很多恐惧在夜里会被放大，天亮后可能没那么可怕。
up.en: Sitting up in bed at night, hands over your face, nine swords on the wall. Fears grow large at night; by daylight they may shrink.

rev.zh: 焦虑开始减轻，或者终于愿意说出心里的担忧、寻求帮助。
rev.en: Anxiety easing, or finally voicing your worries and asking for help.

whispers.zh: 我睡不着。墙上的剑一直在。我数到第九把就开始从头数。
whispers.en: I can't sleep. The swords on the wall are still there. When I reach nine, I start over.

whispers.zh: 蜡烛还亮着。只要它亮着，我就不是一个人。
whispers.en: The candle is still lit. As long as it is, I'm not alone.

scene.zh: 漆黑的夜里，奶蛙在雕花木床上坐起，双手捂着脸颊，床头一支小蜡烛亮着，身后深色石墙上整齐横挂着九把银剑。
scene.en: In the dark of night Naiwa sits up in a carved wooden bed, hands pressed to its cheeks, a small candle lit on the bedside, nine silver swords hung in rows on the dark stone wall behind.

origin.zh: 韦特牌中，一个人深夜从床上坐起掩面哭泣，墙上横挂九把剑，被子上绣着玫瑰与星座符号。它是焦虑、噩梦与自责，很多痛苦来自脑中而非现实。
origin.en: In the Rider–Waite card a figure sits up in bed weeping into their hands, nine swords on the wall, a quilt patterned with roses and astrological signs. It is anxiety, nightmares and guilt — much of the pain lives in the mind.

astro.zh: 双子座第二旬 · 火星（10–20°）

love.zh: 对关系过度担心、胡思乱想。
love.en: Overthinking and worrying about the relationship.

work.zh: 工作压力导致失眠，担心犯错或被否定。
work.en: Work stress causing insomnia; fear of mistakes or rejection.

advice.zh: 把担心写下来，看看哪些真的会发生。
advice.en: Write the worries down and see which could really happen.

love.zh: 最坏的时刻过去了，焦虑慢慢平复。
love.en: The worst has passed; anxiety slowly settles.

work.zh: 开始求助，或者找到减压的方法。
work.en: Seeking help, or finding ways to ease stress.

advice.zh: 天亮了，先拉开窗帘。
advice.en: It's morning — open the curtains first.

up.zh: 奶蛙趴在岸边，十把剑插在身旁，天边已经透出金色的光。最糟的已经发生了——接下来只会往上走。
up.en: Naiwa lies face-down on the shore with ten swords beside it, golden light already on the horizon. The worst has happened — from here, the only way is up.

rev.zh: 从低谷慢慢爬起来，或者拒绝承认一件事已经结束。
rev.en: Slowly climbing out of the low point, or refusing to accept something has ended.

whispers.zh: 我趴着。不是倒下了，是在休息。剑都没碰到我。
whispers.en: I'm lying face-down. Not fallen — resting. None of the swords touched me.

whispers.zh: 天快亮了。我再趴一会儿就起来。
whispers.en: Dawn is coming. I'll lie here a bit longer, then get up.

scene.zh: 黑色夜空的尽头透出第一缕金色晨光，奶蛙毫发无伤地趴在深色鹅卵石岸边休息，眼睛睁着，十把银剑在它身旁插成一排，平静的暗色海水映着微光。
scene.en: At the edge of a black night sky the first golden dawn breaks; Naiwa lies unharmed and resting face-down on a dark pebble shore, eyes open, ten silver swords planted in a row beside it, calm dark water catching the light.

origin.zh: 传统画面中，一个人趴在地上，背上插着十把剑，天空漆黑，但地平线上已经泛起金光。它是彻底的终结与触底，也是「最黑暗的时刻过去后，黎明就会到来」。
origin.en: Traditionally a figure lies face-down with ten swords in his back under a black sky, while the horizon glows gold. It is total ending and rock bottom — and the promise that dawn follows the darkest hour.

astro.zh: 双子座第三旬 · 太阳（20–30°）

love.zh: 一段关系彻底结束，痛但也终于清楚了。
love.en: A relationship fully ends — painful, but finally clear.

work.zh: 项目失败或职业低谷，触底之后才能反弹。
work.en: A failed project or career low — bounce back starts from the bottom.

advice.zh: 承认它结束了，然后给自己一个新的早晨。
advice.en: Admit it's over, then give yourself a new morning.

love.zh: 正在恢复，伤口慢慢长好。
love.en: Recovering; the wounds are slowly healing.

work.zh: 拒绝放手，让痛苦拖得更久。
work.en: Refusing to let go, prolonging the pain.

advice.zh: 站起来不用很快，但要开始。
advice.en: You needn't stand up fast — just begin.

up.zh: 站在风大的山丘上，握剑警觉地看着天空。思维敏锐、求知欲强，适合学习、调查和提问。
up.en: On a windy hill, sword in hand, watching the sky alertly. A sharp, curious mind — good for learning, investigating and asking questions.

rev.zh: 说话尖刻、爱八卦，或者只有想法没有行动。
rev.en: Sharp-tongued, gossipy, or all ideas and no action.

whispers.zh: 我在看鸟。它们飞过去了。我记住了它们的方向。
whispers.en: I'm watching the birds. They flew past. I memorized their direction.

whispers.zh: 风把披风吹起来了。我握紧剑，假装很警觉。其实是很警觉。
whispers.en: The wind lifted my cape. I gripped my sword and pretended to be alert. I actually am.

scene.zh: 清爽的白天，风把云吹得飞快，奶蛙披着石板蓝的短斗篷站在草坡上，双手握着直立的银剑，警觉地看着一群飞过的鸟。
scene.en: In crisp daylight with clouds racing, Naiwa in a short slate-blue cape stands on a grassy hilltop holding a silver sword upright, alertly watching a flock of birds fly past.

origin.zh: 韦特牌中，年轻人站在风吹的高地上，双手持剑，回头警惕地望着，天上有鸟群。宝剑侍从代表好奇、敏锐与求知，也有爱打探消息的一面。
origin.en: In the Rider–Waite card a youth stands on windy high ground holding a sword, glancing warily over his shoulder as birds fly overhead. The Page of Swords is curious, sharp and eager to learn — and likes to gather gossip.

astro.zh: 风中之土（宫廷牌元素，现代常用对应）
astro.en: Earth of Air (court element, common modern attribution)

love.zh: 对对方充满好奇，聊天聊得很投机。
love.en: Curious about each other; conversations flow.

work.zh: 适合学习、写作、调研，或接到新的信息。
work.en: Good for study, writing, research, or receiving new information.

advice.zh: 多问一个「为什么」。
advice.en: Ask one more 'why'.

love.zh: 话太直、伤人，或者喜欢打听别人的事。
love.en: Too blunt and hurtful, or nosy about others.

work.zh: 空谈多于行动，或被流言影响。
work.en: More talk than action, or swayed by rumours.

advice.zh: 先查证，再开口。
advice.en: Check before you speak.

up.zh: 骑着白马全速冲锋，剑高高举起。目标清楚、行动迅速，适合直面问题、一鼓作气。
up.en: Charging full speed on a white horse, sword raised high. Clear aim and swift action — tackle the problem head-on.

rev.zh: 太过急躁、不顾后果，或言辞锋利伤了人。
rev.en: Too hasty, heedless of consequences, or words that cut too deep.

whispers.zh: 马跑得太快了。我的肚子被风吹得往后飘。
whispers.en: The horse is too fast. My belly is blown backwards by the wind.

whispers.zh: 我在冲锋。前面是云。我不怕云。
whispers.en: I'm charging. Ahead are clouds. I'm not afraid of clouds.

scene.zh: 阳光从被风撕开的云层里打下来，奶蛙穿着轻银甲、披着风暴蓝短斗篷，骑着白马全速冲过荒原，高举银剑，羽毛在身边打转。
scene.en: Sunbeams break through wind-torn clouds as Naiwa in light silver armour and a storm-blue cape gallops a white horse across a moor, sword held high, feathers swirling.

origin.zh: 传统画面中，骑士骑着白马全速冲锋，高举长剑，云层与树木被狂风吹向一边。他是行动最快的骑士：果断、勇敢，也可能鲁莽冲动。
origin.en: Traditionally the knight charges at full gallop on a white horse, sword raised, clouds and trees bent by the gale. He is the fastest knight: decisive and brave — and possibly reckless.

astro.zh: 风中之风（宫廷牌元素，现代常用对应）
astro.en: Air of Air (court element, common modern attribution)

love.zh: 直接表白或直接摊牌，进展很快。
love.en: A direct confession or showdown; things move fast.

work.zh: 雷厉风行、快速解决问题的时机。
work.en: Time to act fast and solve the problem.

advice.zh: 冲之前，确认一下马的方向。
advice.en: Before charging, check which way the horse is facing.

love.zh: 说话太冲，或者不考虑对方感受。
love.en: Too blunt, ignoring the other's feelings.

work.zh: 冒进、做事不顾后果。
work.en: Rash moves without thinking of consequences.

advice.zh: 慢下来，听一听再决定。
advice.en: Slow down, listen, then decide.

up.zh: 她坐在高处的石座上，一手握剑、一手抬起。清醒、独立、说话直接，用理性保护自己也帮助别人。
up.en: She sits on a high stone throne, sword in one hand, the other raised. Clear-sighted, independent and direct — she uses reason to protect herself and help others.

rev.zh: 过于冷淡、尖刻，或者被过去的伤痛困住，变得刻薄。
rev.en: Too cold or cutting, or embittered by old wounds.

whispers.zh: 我举起一只手。不是打招呼，是表示我在听。
whispers.en: I raised a hand. Not hello — it means I'm listening.

whispers.zh: 王座上刻着蝴蝶。它们很轻，我的剑很重。我们很平衡。
whispers.en: Butterflies are carved on my throne. They're light, my sword is heavy. We balance.

scene.zh: 清澈明亮的高空白天，奶蛙戴着银色小冠、披着灰蓝斗篷，端坐在刻着蝴蝶的高大石座上，一手竖握银剑、一手平静地抬起，云在脚下飘。
scene.en: In crisp, bright high-altitude daylight Naiwa, in a silver crown and grey-blue cape, sits upright on a tall butterfly-carved stone throne, sword held vertical in one hand and the other raised calmly, clouds drifting below.

origin.zh: 韦特牌中，王后侧身坐在饰有蝴蝶与天使头像的王座上，一手竖剑、一手伸出，天上飞着一只鸟。她是经历过痛苦后的清醒与智慧：坦率、公正、独立。
origin.en: In the Rider–Waite card the Queen sits in profile on a throne carved with butterflies and a cherub, sword upright, one hand extended, a single bird above. She is clarity and wisdom earned through sorrow: frank, fair and independent.

astro.zh: 风中之水（宫廷牌元素，现代常用对应）
astro.en: Water of Air (court element, common modern attribution)

love.zh: 需要真诚直接的沟通，不必讨好。
love.en: Honest, direct communication — no need to please.

work.zh: 适合需要判断力的工作：分析、写作、法律、管理。
work.en: Good for work that needs judgement: analysis, writing, law, management.

advice.zh: 说真话，但保留温度。
advice.en: Speak the truth, but keep it warm.

love.zh: 过于挑剔或冷漠，让对方难以靠近。
love.en: Too critical or cold to let them close.

work.zh: 言辞刻薄，或被情绪蒙蔽判断。
work.en: Cutting words, or judgement clouded by feelings.

advice.zh: 放下一点防备，不是所有人都会伤你。
advice.en: Lower your guard a little — not everyone will hurt you.

up.zh: 他正面端坐，剑竖得笔直。理性、公正、有原则，用清晰的判断做出决定。
up.en: He faces forward with his sword perfectly upright. Rational, fair and principled — he decides with clear judgement.

rev.zh: 冷酷、专断，或用权力和道理压人。
rev.en: Cold, authoritarian, or using power and logic to dominate.

whispers.zh: 剑要竖得很直。我已经保持这个姿势一个小时了。
whispers.en: The sword must be perfectly upright. I've held this pose for an hour.

whispers.zh: 我在思考。表情和不思考的时候一样。
whispers.en: I'm thinking. My face looks the same as when I'm not.

scene.zh: 蓝天白云的清爽白天，奶蛙戴着银色小冠、穿深蓝长袍，正面端坐在刻着蝴蝶与新月的高大石座上，一手竖握银剑，身后是高高的柏树和被风吹散的云。
scene.en: On a clear day of blue sky and white cloud Naiwa, in a silver crown and deep blue robe, sits facing forward on a tall stone throne carved with butterflies and crescents, sword held upright, tall cypresses and windswept clouds behind.

origin.zh: 传统画面中，国王正面坐在饰有蝴蝶与新月的王座上，手持微微倾斜的剑，背后是高高的树和飞鸟。他是理性与法则的掌控者：公正、权威、以思想统御。
origin.en: Traditionally the King sits facing forward on a throne of butterflies and crescents, sword slightly tilted, tall trees and birds behind. He masters reason and law: just, authoritative, ruling by thought.

astro.zh: 风中之火（宫廷牌元素，现代常用对应）
astro.en: Fire of Air (court element, common modern attribution)

love.zh: 理性成熟的伴侣，或需要把规则和边界谈清楚。
love.en: A rational, mature partner, or a need to agree on rules and boundaries.

work.zh: 适合做决策、制定规则、处理法律与合同。
work.en: Good for decisions, setting rules, legal matters and contracts.

advice.zh: 用事实说话，用原则做决定。
advice.en: Let facts speak and principles decide.

love.zh: 太讲道理而忽视感情，或控制欲强。
love.en: All logic, no feeling, or controlling.

work.zh: 独断专行，或者用规则压人。
work.en: Autocratic, or using rules to dominate.

advice.zh: 道理之外，还有人心。
advice.en: Beyond reason, there are hearts.

up.zh: 一枚金色星币从云中递来，下方是盛开的花园。一个实实在在的机会：新工作、新收入或一个可以落地的计划。
up.en: A golden coin is offered from the clouds above a blooming garden. A tangible opportunity: a new job, new income, or a plan you can make real.

rev.zh: 机会错过、计划不落地，或者把钱和精力花在了不对的地方。
rev.en: A missed chance, plans that never land, or money and energy spent in the wrong place.

whispers.zh: 那枚金币很大。我想把它种在花园里，看会不会长出更多。
whispers.en: That coin is huge. I want to plant it in the garden and see if more grow.

whispers.zh: 花园的拱门开着。我还在门口，没有进去。
whispers.en: The garden arch is open. I'm still at the gate.

scene.zh: 明亮的清晨阳光穿过花园，一只金光做的手从白云里托出一枚巨大的星币；下方玫瑰拱门通往远处的青山，奶蛙站在花园小路上仰头看着。
scene.en: Bright morning sun fills a garden as a hand of golden light offers a great star-coin from a white cloud; below, a rose arch opens onto blue hills and Naiwa looks up from the path.

origin.zh: 韦特牌中，一只手从云中托着刻有五芒星的金币，下方是百合盛开的花园，一道树篱拱门通向远山。它是土元素之根：物质、身体、财富与把想法变成现实的能力。
origin.en: In the Rider–Waite card a hand from a cloud holds a pentacle above a garden of lilies, a hedge arch opening onto distant mountains. It is the root of Earth: matter, body, wealth and the power to make ideas real.

astro.zh: 土元素之根

love.zh: 一段踏实、可以长久的关系开始了。
love.en: A grounded, lasting relationship begins.

work.zh: 新工作、加薪、投资机会，或者一个能赚钱的点子。
work.en: A new job, a raise, an investment, or an idea that can earn.

advice.zh: 从一件具体可执行的小事做起。
advice.en: Start with one concrete, doable thing.

love.zh: 想要稳定却缺乏行动，或物质条件成了阻碍。
love.en: Wanting stability without acting, or money getting in the way.

work.zh: 错失机会、预算超支，计划只停留在纸上。
work.en: Missed chances, overspending, plans stuck on paper.

advice.zh: 先管好手上的这一枚。
advice.en: Take care of the coin you already hold.

up.zh: 一边跳舞一边抛接两枚星币，身后船只在大浪里起伏。生活很忙，但你还应付得来，保持灵活和节奏。
up.en: Dancing while juggling two coins as ships ride big waves behind. Life is busy, but you're keeping up — stay flexible and keep the rhythm.

rev.zh: 事情太多手忙脚乱，或者财务和时间失去平衡。
rev.en: Too much at once, or money and time out of balance.

whispers.zh: 我在抛两枚金币。它们连着一根丝带，所以不会掉。我很聪明。
whispers.en: I'm juggling two coins. They're tied with a ribbon, so they can't fall. I'm very clever.

whispers.zh: 后面的船在晃。我也在晃。我们在同一个节奏里。
whispers.en: The ships behind are rocking. So am I. We share a rhythm.

scene.zh: 阳光和白云的正午，奶蛙在花园露台上踮脚跳着小舞步，抛接两枚由绿色丝带连成无限符号的星币，矮墙后的海面上两艘船在大浪里起伏。
scene.en: Under a breezy noon sun Naiwa does a little dance on a garden terrace, juggling two coins linked by a green infinity ribbon, two ships riding high waves beyond the wall.

origin.zh: 传统画面中，一个戴高帽的年轻人边跳舞边抛接两枚星币，两枚币被无限符号形的带子相连，背景是在巨浪中起伏的船。它代表在变化中保持平衡与灵活应变。
origin.en: Traditionally a young man in a tall hat dances while juggling two pentacles joined by an infinity-shaped band, ships tossing on great waves behind. It means keeping balance and adapting amid change.

astro.zh: 摩羯座第一旬 · 木星（0–10°）

love.zh: 在感情和其他事务之间找平衡，或者暧昧中保持轻松。
love.en: Balancing love with everything else, or keeping a flirtation light.

work.zh: 兼顾多个项目、副业，或处理收支平衡。
work.en: Juggling projects, a side job, or balancing income and spending.

advice.zh: 给每件事排个先后，抛接会更稳。
advice.en: Put things in order — the juggling gets steadier.

love.zh: 忙到忽略了对方。
love.en: So busy you neglect each other.

work.zh: 精力分散、账目混乱，开始顾此失彼。
work.en: Spread too thin, accounts in a mess, dropping balls.

advice.zh: 放下一个球，才能接住另一个。
advice.en: Drop one ball to catch another.

up.zh: 石匠奶蛙在拱门上精雕细琢，另外两人拿着图纸讨论。专业能力被看见，团队合作带来好作品。
up.en: Stonemason Naiwa carves the arch with care while two others study the plans. Skill is noticed; teamwork makes good work.

rev.zh: 合作不顺、各说各话，或者手艺没被重视。
rev.en: Poor teamwork, everyone talking past each other, or skill undervalued.

whispers.zh: 我在刻拱门。下面两位在看图纸。我们三个都不知道图纸是谁画的。
whispers.en: I'm carving the arch. The two below are reading the plans. None of us knows who drew them.

whispers.zh: 锤子敲下去，石头掉一点。慢慢地，它就变好看了。
whispers.en: Tap the hammer, a bit of stone falls. Slowly it becomes beautiful.

scene.zh: 温暖明亮的午后，奶蛙站在木脚手架上雕刻一座浅色石头的花园拱门，拱门上嵌着三枚呈三角形排列的星币；下方两个穿棕色长袍、戴兜帽的小身影展开图纸讨论。
scene.en: In warm bright afternoon light Naiwa stands on a wooden scaffold carving a pale stone garden arch set with three coins in a triangle, while two small hooded figures in brown robes unroll a plan below.

origin.zh: 韦特牌中，一位石匠站在长凳上雕刻教堂的拱门，一位修士和一位拿着图纸的贵人在旁边商议，拱门上刻着三枚星币。它代表专业技艺、团队协作，以及作品得到认可。
origin.en: In the Rider–Waite card a stonemason on a bench carves a cathedral arch while a monk and a patron holding plans confer beside him, three pentacles carved above. It means skilled craft, collaboration and recognition of good work.

astro.zh: 摩羯座第二旬 · 火星（10–20°）

love.zh: 两个人一起经营、规划未来，关系越来越踏实。
love.en: Building and planning together; the relationship grows solid.

work.zh: 专业得到认可，适合团队合作、拜师学艺。
work.en: Your expertise is recognized; good for teamwork or apprenticeship.

advice.zh: 把你擅长的那一部分做到最好。
advice.en: Do the part you're best at, and do it well.

love.zh: 彼此不配合，各自为政。
love.en: Not working together, each going their own way.

work.zh: 沟通不畅、标准不一，或者努力没被看见。
work.en: Poor communication, mismatched standards, effort unseen.

advice.zh: 先对齐图纸，再动锤子。
advice.en: Agree on the plan before picking up the hammer.

up.zh: 紧紧抱着星币、头上顶一枚、脚下踩两枚。守住已有的东西很重要，但抓得太紧也会失去流动。
up.en: Hugging one coin, one on the head, two under the feet. Protecting what you have matters — but grip too hard and nothing can flow.

rev.zh: 学会放手与分享，或者因为过度紧张反而失去。
rev.en: Learning to let go and share — or losing it all by clutching too tight.

whispers.zh: 我抱着一枚，头上顶着一枚，脚下踩着两枚。我哪也去不了，但它们都很安全。
whispers.en: One in my arms, one on my head, two under my feet. I can't go anywhere, but they're all safe.

whispers.zh: 有人问我借一枚。我假装没听见。
whispers.en: Someone asked to borrow one. I pretended not to hear.

scene.zh: 晴朗的正午，奶蛙坐在城镇前的石凳上，紧紧抱着一枚大星币贴在肚子上，头顶稳稳地顶着一枚，两只三趾脚下各踩一枚。
scene.en: At clear noon Naiwa sits on a stone bench before a sunny walled town, hugging one big coin to its belly, another balanced on its head, two under its three-toed feet.

origin.zh: 传统画面中，一个戴王冠的人坐在城外，双手紧抱一枚星币，头上和脚下各有星币。它代表守财、控制与安全感，也提醒过度执着会让人封闭。
origin.en: Traditionally a crowned man sits outside a city clutching one pentacle, with others on his crown and under his feet. It is saving, control and security — and a warning that over-attachment closes you off.

astro.zh: 摩羯座第三旬 · 太阳（20–30°）

love.zh: 占有欲强，或因为害怕失去而不敢投入。
love.en: Possessive, or afraid to fully commit for fear of loss.

work.zh: 适合存钱、守住成果，但别太保守。
work.en: Good for saving and protecting gains — but don't be too conservative.

advice.zh: 想想：你在守护，还是在害怕？
advice.en: Ask: are you protecting, or just afraid?

love.zh: 学会信任，给对方空间。
love.en: Learning to trust and give space.

work.zh: 开始投资或分享资源；也可能是财务失控。
work.en: Starting to invest or share — or losing control of money.

advice.zh: 松开一点手，东西才会流进来。
advice.en: Loosen your grip so things can flow in.

up.zh: 两只奶蛙在雪夜里艰难前行，经过一扇透着暖光的窗。困难是真的，但帮助可能就在旁边，只是你还没敲门。
up.en: Two Naiwas trudge through a snowy night past a warmly lit window. The hardship is real — but help may be right beside you, if you knock.

rev.zh: 最难的时候过去了，开始接受帮助、慢慢恢复。
rev.en: The worst is over; you begin accepting help and recovering.

whispers.zh: 雪很深。我们走得很慢。窗户里很暖，但我们没有敲门。
whispers.en: The snow is deep. We walk slowly. It's warm behind the window, but we didn't knock.

whispers.zh: 我们两个靠在一起走。这样冷一半。
whispers.en: We walk leaning on each other. That way it's half as cold.

scene.zh: 寒冷的雪夜，两只裹着破旧补丁斗篷的奶蛙在窄窄的哥特小巷里艰难地踩着深雪前行，其中一只拄着小拐杖，头顶一扇彩色花窗透出温暖的金光，窗上有花纹和五枚星币。
scene.en: On a cold snowy night two Naiwas in worn, patched cloaks trudge through deep snow down a narrow gothic street, one on a small crutch, beneath a glowing leaded window patterned with flowers and five coins.

origin.zh: 韦特牌中，两个衣衫褴褛的人在雪中蹒跚走过教堂的彩窗，其中一人拄着拐杖，窗上透出五枚星币的光。它代表贫困、病痛与被排斥，也暗示庇护其实近在咫尺。
origin.en: In the Rider–Waite card two ragged figures, one on crutches, stumble through snow past a lit church window showing five pentacles. It means poverty, illness and exclusion — and shelter that is closer than it seems.

astro.zh: 金牛座第一旬 · 水星（0–10°）

love.zh: 感到被冷落，或两个人一起经历艰难时期。
love.en: Feeling left out, or going through hard times together.

work.zh: 收入减少、失业或资源不足。
work.en: Lower income, job loss, or lack of resources.

advice.zh: 敲敲那扇亮着的门，开口求助。
advice.en: Knock on the lit door — ask for help.

love.zh: 关系熬过低谷，开始回暖。
love.en: The relationship survives the low and warms up.

work.zh: 财务状况好转，找到新的支持。
work.en: Finances improve; new support appears.

advice.zh: 接受帮助，不是软弱。
advice.en: Accepting help isn't weakness.

up.zh: 奶蛙一手拿着天平，一手把星币分给需要的人。有给有收，资源在流动中变得公平。
up.en: Naiwa holds a balance in one hand and gives coins with the other. Giving and receiving keep resources flowing fairly.

rev.zh: 给予带着条件，或者付出与回报严重失衡。
rev.en: Strings attached to giving, or a badly lopsided give-and-take.

whispers.zh: 我在发金币。天平是用来确认我没有多给的。
whispers.en: I'm handing out coins. The scale is to make sure I don't give too much.

whispers.zh: 他们跪着。我说站起来吧，地上凉。
whispers.en: They're kneeling. I said get up, the ground is cold.

scene.zh: 明亮温暖的正午，果园旁的小镇广场上，奶蛙披着深红商人斗篷，一手提着金色小天平，一手把星币递给两只跪在面前的小奶蛙。
scene.en: At bright warm noon in a town square by an orchard, Naiwa in a deep red merchant's cape holds a small golden scale in one hand and gives coins to two small Naiwas kneeling before it.

origin.zh: 传统画面中，一位富商一手持天平，一手向跪地的乞丐施舍金币。它讲的是慷慨与公平，也提醒人们注意施与受之间的权力关系。
origin.en: Traditionally a wealthy merchant holds scales in one hand and gives coins to kneeling beggars with the other. It is generosity and fairness — and a reminder of the power between giver and receiver.

astro.zh: 金牛座第二旬 · 月亮（10–20°）

love.zh: 互相照顾、付出对等的关系。
love.en: A relationship of mutual care and balanced giving.

work.zh: 得到资助、奖金，或适合做公益与分享。
work.en: Funding, a bonus, or a good time for charity and sharing.

advice.zh: 今天帮一个人，也接受一次帮助。
advice.en: Help someone today, and accept help once too.

love.zh: 一方一直给，一方一直拿。
love.en: One always gives, the other always takes.

work.zh: 借钱不还、付出不被认可，或带着控制的施舍。
work.en: Unpaid loans, unrecognized effort, or giving used as control.

advice.zh: 给之前，先看看自己的口袋。
advice.en: Before giving, check your own pockets.

up.zh: 奶蛙拄着锄头看灌木上长出的星币。收获需要时间，现在是停下来评估、调整方向的时候。
up.en: Naiwa leans on a hoe watching coins grow on a bush. Harvest takes time; now is the moment to pause, assess and adjust.

rev.zh: 急于求成、看不到回报而灰心，或者投入方向不对。
rev.en: Impatient for results, discouraged by slow returns, or investing in the wrong place.

whispers.zh: 金币长在树上。我在等它们熟。已经等了三天。
whispers.en: The coins grow on the bush. I'm waiting for them to ripen. Three days so far.

whispers.zh: 我戴了草帽。这样看起来更像在思考。
whispers.en: I'm wearing a straw hat. It makes me look more thoughtful.

scene.zh: 温暖的夏末午后，奶蛙戴着草帽倚着长柄锄头，若有所思地看着一丛绿叶灌木上像果实一样长着的七枚星币，身后是菜园和旧石墙。
scene.en: On a warm late-summer afternoon Naiwa in a straw hat leans on a long hoe, thoughtfully watching seven coins growing like fruit on a leafy bush, a vegetable garden and old stone wall behind.

origin.zh: 韦特牌中，一位农夫倚着锄头，凝视藤蔓上长出的七枚星币，神情疲惫又若有所思。它代表耕耘之后的等待、阶段性评估与长期的投入。
origin.en: In the Rider–Waite card a farmer leans on his hoe gazing at seven pentacles growing on a vine, tired and thoughtful. It is the waiting after labour, taking stock, and long-term investment.

astro.zh: 金牛座第三旬 · 土星（20–30°）

love.zh: 关系需要时间慢慢培养，别急着要结果。
love.en: The relationship needs time to grow; don't rush the outcome.

work.zh: 长期项目进入观察期，适合复盘和调整策略。
work.en: A long project in review — time to assess and adjust.

advice.zh: 看看哪些种子值得继续浇水。
advice.en: See which seeds are worth watering.

love.zh: 付出很多却看不到回应，开始动摇。
love.en: Giving a lot without response, starting to waver.

work.zh: 投资回报差，或者半途而废。
work.en: Poor returns, or giving up halfway.

advice.zh: 不是所有种子都会发芽，换一块地也可以。
advice.en: Not every seed sprouts — you can try another plot.

up.zh: 系着皮围裙在工作台前一枚一枚地雕刻星币。专注、重复、精益求精——手艺就是这样练成的。
up.en: In a leather apron at the workbench, carving coins one by one. Focus, repetition, refinement — that's how craft is built.

rev.zh: 敷衍了事、追求速度忽视质量，或者陷入重复失去意义。
rev.en: Cutting corners, speed over quality, or stuck in meaningless repetition.

whispers.zh: 这是第八枚。每一枚我都刻得一样认真。
whispers.en: This is the eighth. I carved each one just as carefully.

whispers.zh: 锤子轻轻敲。星星慢慢出来。
whispers.en: Tap the hammer gently. The star slowly appears.

scene.zh: 明亮清晨的阳光下，奶蛙系着小皮围裙坐在作坊外结实的木工作台前，用小凿子和锤子在一枚金币上刻五芒星，旁边木柱上挂着已经完成的星币，一共八枚。
scene.en: In bright morning sun Naiwa in a small leather apron sits at a sturdy workbench outside a workshop, carving a five-pointed star into a gold coin with a chisel and hammer; finished coins hang on a post beside it, eight in all.

origin.zh: 传统画面中，一位工匠坐在长凳上专心地雕刻星币，已完成的作品挂在一旁的柱子上，远处是城镇。它是学徒精神：专注练习、精进技艺、脚踏实地地积累。
origin.en: Traditionally a craftsman sits at a bench intently carving pentacles, finished ones displayed on a post, a town in the distance. It is the apprentice's spirit: focused practice, honing skill, building steadily.

astro.zh: 处女座第一旬 · 太阳（0–10°）

love.zh: 用行动而不是言语经营感情，一点点变好。
love.en: Showing love through effort, not words, improving bit by bit.

work.zh: 适合进修、练技能、埋头做好手上的活。
work.en: Good for training, skill-building and focusing on the work at hand.

advice.zh: 今天把一件小事做到满意为止。
advice.en: Do one small thing today until you're satisfied with it.

love.zh: 只顾工作，忽略了陪伴。
love.en: Too absorbed in work, neglecting time together.

work.zh: 敷衍、急躁，或重复劳动让人倦怠。
work.en: Sloppiness, impatience, or burnout from repetition.

advice.zh: 问问自己：现在练的，是你想要的吗？
advice.en: Ask: is what you're practising what you want?

up.zh: 穿着华服站在葡萄园里，手上停着一只猎鹰。靠自己的努力获得了富足与自在，可以好好享受。
up.en: In fine robes in a vineyard, a falcon on your hand. Abundance and ease earned through your own work — enjoy it.

rev.zh: 表面风光内心空虚，或过度依赖他人、花钱失度。
rev.en: Fine on the outside, empty inside, or overdependent and overspending.

whispers.zh: 我手上有一只鹰。它戴着小帽子，所以不会飞走，也不会啄我。
whispers.en: There's a falcon on my hand. It wears a little hood, so it won't fly off or peck me.

whispers.zh: 葡萄园里挂着九枚金币。都是我自己挂上去的。
whispers.en: Nine coins hang in the vineyard. I hung them all myself.

scene.zh: 温暖的金色午后，奶蛙穿着绣金的绿色长袍站在茂盛的葡萄园里，举起的三指小手上停着一只戴头罩的小猎鹰，九枚星币挂在葡萄藤间，远处是一座宅邸。
scene.en: In warm golden afternoon light Naiwa in a gold-embroidered green robe stands in a lush vineyard, a small hooded falcon on its raised hand, nine coins hanging among the vines, a manor in the distance.

origin.zh: 韦特牌中，一位衣着华丽的女子站在丰收的葡萄园里，手上停着戴头罩的猎鹰，身旁九枚星币。她代表通过自律与努力得来的独立、优雅与富足。
origin.en: In the Rider–Waite card an elegantly dressed woman stands in a fruitful vineyard with a hooded falcon on her hand, nine pentacles beside her. She is independence, refinement and abundance earned through discipline.

astro.zh: 处女座第二旬 · 金星（10–20°）

love.zh: 享受独处，或在关系中保持独立和自我价值。
love.en: Enjoying solitude, or keeping your independence within a relationship.

work.zh: 经济独立、事业有成，生活品质提升。
work.en: Financial independence, career success, a better quality of life.

advice.zh: 奖励自己一样好东西，你值得。
advice.en: Treat yourself to something good — you've earned it.

love.zh: 用物质填补情感空缺。
love.en: Filling emotional gaps with things.

work.zh: 财务依赖他人，或消费失控。
work.en: Financial dependence, or spending out of control.

advice.zh: 真正的富足包括心里的那一份。
advice.en: True abundance includes the kind inside.

up.zh: 拱门上嵌着十枚星币，三代奶蛙和两只白狗在庭院里。长久的富足、家族的传承与稳固的根基。
up.en: Ten coins set into the archway; three generations of Naiwas and two white dogs in the courtyard. Lasting wealth, family legacy and solid roots.

rev.zh: 家族纠纷、遗产问题，或者被传统和责任束缚。
rev.en: Family disputes, inheritance issues, or feeling bound by tradition and duty.

whispers.zh: 拱门上有十枚金币。最老的那只奶蛙说，以前只有一枚。
whispers.en: Ten coins on the archway. The oldest Naiwa says there used to be just one.

whispers.zh: 小的那只在摸狗。狗很白，摸起来很软。
whispers.en: The little one is petting the dogs. They're very white and very soft.

scene.zh: 明亮温暖的午后，爬满常春藤的宏伟石拱门上嵌着十枚星币，拱门下的庭院里，年长的奶蛙穿着花纹华袍坐在长椅上，两只成年奶蛙在聊天，一只小奶蛙在摸两只友好的白狗，拱门外是繁荣的小镇。
scene.en: On a bright warm afternoon an ivy-covered stone archway is set with ten coins; in the courtyard an elder Naiwa in a patterned robe sits on a bench, two adults chat, and a small Naiwa pets two friendly white dogs, a prosperous town beyond.

origin.zh: 传统画面中，一位老人坐在拱门下抚摸两只白狗，一对年轻夫妇和孩子在旁，十枚星币排列成生命之树的形状。它是物质层面的最终圆满：家族、财富与世代传承。
origin.en: Traditionally an old man sits beneath an archway stroking two white dogs, a young couple and child nearby, ten pentacles arranged as the Tree of Life. It is material fulfilment at its peak: family, wealth and generations.

astro.zh: 处女座第三旬 · 水星（20–30°）

love.zh: 关系稳定长久，得到家人支持，适合谈婚论嫁。
love.en: A stable, lasting bond with family support — time to talk marriage.

work.zh: 家族企业、长期资产、稳定的职业根基。
work.en: Family business, long-term assets, a secure career foundation.

advice.zh: 想想你想留给以后的是什么。
advice.en: Think about what you want to leave behind.

love.zh: 家人意见左右关系，或门第观念造成压力。
love.en: Family opinions sway the relationship, or pressure over background.

work.zh: 财产纠纷、家族期待太重。
work.en: Property disputes, or heavy family expectations.

advice.zh: 传承可以选择，不必全盘接收。
advice.en: You can choose what to inherit.

up.zh: 在春天的草地上双手举着一枚星币仔细端详。一个踏实的学生：认真学习、规划未来、从小处开始。
up.en: In a spring meadow, holding up a coin and studying it closely. A diligent student: learning carefully, planning ahead, starting small.

rev.zh: 只想不做、拖延，或者对学习失去兴趣。
rev.en: All plans and no action, procrastination, or losing interest in learning.

whispers.zh: 我在看这枚金币。它很圆，和我一样。
whispers.en: I'm studying this coin. It's round, like me.

whispers.zh: 草地上的花开了。我没有看花，因为我在学习。
whispers.en: The meadow flowers are blooming. I'm not looking at them; I'm studying.

scene.zh: 清新明亮的春日早晨，奶蛙穿着苔绿色短斗篷、戴着小帽站在开满鲜花的草地上，双手举着一枚星币，一本正经地端详着，身后是犁过的田和一片树林。
scene.en: On a fresh bright spring morning Naiwa in a moss-green cape and small cap stands in a flowering meadow, holding up a coin with both hands and studying it gravely, ploughed fields and a grove behind.

origin.zh: 韦特牌中，一位年轻人站在开花的田野上，双手托着星币专注地凝视，远处是犁过的土地。星币侍从是勤奋的学徒，代表学习、新的财务或事业计划，以及踏实的开端。
origin.en: In the Rider–Waite card a youth in a flowering field gazes intently at the pentacle he holds up, ploughed land beyond. The Page of Pentacles is the diligent apprentice: study, new financial or career plans, steady beginnings.

astro.zh: 土中之土（宫廷牌元素，现代常用对应）
astro.en: Earth of Earth (court element, common modern attribution)

love.zh: 慢热但认真，一步一步建立信任。
love.en: Slow to warm but sincere, building trust step by step.

work.zh: 适合考证、进修、开始一份新工作或理财计划。
work.en: Good for exams, courses, a new job, or a savings plan.

advice.zh: 今天学一点点新东西。
advice.en: Learn a little something new today.

love.zh: 想得多做得少，关系停在原地。
love.en: Thinking a lot, doing little; things stand still.

work.zh: 拖延、半途而废，或者目标不切实际。
work.en: Procrastination, quitting halfway, or unrealistic goals.

advice.zh: 把大计划切成今天能做的一小块。
advice.en: Cut the big plan into one piece you can do today.

up.zh: 骑着一匹纹丝不动的黑色重挽马，手捧星币望着犁好的田。不急不躁，一步一个脚印，最可靠的骑士。
up.en: On a stock-still black draft horse, holding a coin and gazing at ploughed fields. Unhurried, step by step — the most dependable knight.

rev.zh: 太过保守、固执，或者因为太慢而错过时机。
rev.en: Too cautious, stubborn, or so slow you miss the moment.

whispers.zh: 马一动不动。我也一动不动。我们在等田自己长出东西。
whispers.en: The horse doesn't move. Neither do I. We're waiting for the field to grow something.

whispers.zh: 别的骑士都在冲锋。我在耐心。
whispers.en: The other knights charge. I practise patience.

scene.zh: 温暖稳定的午后阳光里，奶蛙穿着深绿铠甲，耐心地坐在一匹纹丝不动的结实黑色挽马上，双手向前捧着一枚星币，站在犁得整整齐齐的田边，远处有橡树和农舍。
scene.en: In steady warm afternoon sun Naiwa in dark green armour sits patiently on a sturdy black draft horse standing perfectly still at the edge of neatly ploughed fields, holding a coin forward, oaks and a farmhouse beyond.

origin.zh: 传统画面中，骑士坐在静止不动的黑马上，手托星币望着犁过的田地。他是唯一停下脚步的骑士：勤勉、可靠、按部就班，也可能过于保守。
origin.en: Traditionally the knight sits on a motionless black horse holding a pentacle and gazing at ploughed fields. He is the only knight standing still: hardworking, reliable, methodical — and perhaps too cautious.

astro.zh: 土中之风（宫廷牌元素，现代常用对应）
astro.en: Air of Earth (court element, common modern attribution)

love.zh: 慢热但忠诚可靠，给人安全感。
love.en: Slow to warm but loyal and dependable — a source of security.

work.zh: 稳扎稳打的工作阶段，适合长期执行与维护。
work.en: A steady phase of work, good for long execution and upkeep.

advice.zh: 今天不求快，只求把它做完。
advice.en: Don't aim for fast today — just finish it.

love.zh: 太闷、太固执，关系缺少新鲜感。
love.en: Too dull or stubborn; the relationship lacks spark.

work.zh: 停滞不前、墨守成规，错过机会。
work.en: Stagnant, stuck in routine, missing chances.

advice.zh: 偶尔让马走两步也不错。
advice.en: Let the horse take a few steps now and then.

up.zh: 坐在玫瑰花园里的王座上，温柔地捧着一枚星币，脚边一只小白兔。务实又温暖，把生活照顾得井井有条。
up.en: On a throne in a rose garden, tenderly cradling a coin, a little white rabbit at her feet. Practical and warm, she keeps life well tended.

rev.zh: 过度操劳、只顾照顾别人，或者被物质和琐事淹没。
rev.en: Overworked, caring for everyone but yourself, or buried in chores and things.

whispers.zh: 我抱着一枚金币，像抱着一个枕头。
whispers.en: I'm holding a coin like a pillow.

whispers.zh: 脚边有一只兔子。它不说话，但它一直在。
whispers.en: There's a rabbit at my feet. It doesn't talk, but it's always there.

scene.zh: 明亮温暖的正午阳光穿过玫瑰拱门，奶蛙戴着精致的小金冠、披着苔绿天鹅绒斗篷，坐在刻着果实与山羊头的石座上，膝上温柔地捧着一枚大星币，草地上坐着一只小白兔。
scene.en: Bright warm noon light falls through a rose arch onto Naiwa, in a delicate crown and moss-green velvet cape, seated on a stone throne carved with fruit and goat heads, cradling a large coin on its lap, a small white rabbit in the grass.

origin.zh: 韦特牌中，王后坐在饰有果实与山羊头的王座上，膝上捧着星币，周围是花园与玫瑰拱门，脚边有一只兔子。她是大地之母般的存在：务实、慷慨、懂得经营生活。
origin.en: In the Rider–Waite card the Queen sits on a throne of fruit and goat heads, cradling a pentacle in a garden under a rose bower, a rabbit at her feet. She is an earth-mother figure: practical, generous and good at tending life.

astro.zh: 土中之水（宫廷牌元素，现代常用对应）
astro.en: Water of Earth (court element, common modern attribution)

love.zh: 温暖体贴、会照顾人的伴侣，日子过得踏实温馨。
love.en: A warm, caring partner; a cosy, grounded life together.

work.zh: 兼顾工作与家庭，理财有方，事业稳中有升。
work.en: Balancing work and home, good with money, steady growth.

advice.zh: 给自己做一顿好吃的。
advice.en: Cook yourself something good.

love.zh: 照顾别人照顾到忘了自己。
love.en: Caring so much for others you forget yourself.

work.zh: 被家务和琐事拖累，或者过分看重物质。
work.en: Weighed down by chores, or too focused on material things.

advice.zh: 把照顾分一点给自己。
advice.en: Save some of that care for yourself.

up.zh: 坐在刻着公牛头的王座上，长袍绣满葡萄，一手星币一手权杖。事业有成、财务稳固，有能力照顾好身边的人。
up.en: On a bull-carved throne, robe embroidered with grapes, coin in one hand and sceptre in the other. Success, financial security, and the means to care for those around him.

rev.zh: 贪婪、固执，或者用金钱衡量一切。
rev.en: Greed, stubbornness, or measuring everything by money.

whispers.zh: 我的袍子上全是葡萄。我有点饿了。
whispers.en: My robe is covered in grapes. I'm a bit hungry.

whispers.zh: 我坐得很稳。王座很宽，刚好装下我的肚子。
whispers.en: I sit very steadily. The throne is wide — just enough for my belly.

scene.zh: 温暖的金色傍晚，奶蛙戴着缀有小叶子的金冠、穿着绣满葡萄藤的深色长袍，坐在刻着公牛头的宽大石座上，膝上放着一枚大星币，手握金色短权杖，四周是葡萄藤和富饶的城堡花园。
scene.en: In warm golden late-afternoon light Naiwa, in a leaf-trimmed gold crown and a dark robe embroidered with vines, sits on a broad bull-carved throne with a large coin on its knee and a short golden sceptre, grapevines and a rich castle garden around it.

origin.zh: 传统画面中，国王坐在饰有公牛头的王座上，长袍上满是葡萄纹样，手持星币与权杖，身后是城堡与葡萄园。他是物质世界的成功者：富足、稳重、慷慨而有责任感。
origin.en: Traditionally the King sits on a throne carved with bulls, his robe covered in grapes, holding a pentacle and sceptre before a castle and vineyard. He is success in the material world: prosperous, steady, generous and responsible.

astro.zh: 土中之火（宫廷牌元素，现代常用对应）
astro.en: Fire of Earth (court element, common modern attribution)

love.zh: 成熟可靠、能给对方安稳生活的伴侣。
love.en: A mature, dependable partner who can offer a secure life.

work.zh: 事业成熟、投资有成，适合管理资源与团队。
work.en: Career and investments mature; good for managing resources and people.

advice.zh: 用你拥有的，去照顾值得的人。
advice.en: Use what you have to care for those who matter.

love.zh: 太看重物质，或用金钱代替陪伴。
love.en: Too materialistic, or using money instead of presence.

work.zh: 固执守旧、贪多求稳，错失变化。
work.en: Stubborn, greedy for security, missing change.

advice.zh: 财富是工具，不是全部。
advice.en: Wealth is a tool, not everything.
